title: gf2-core SpBitMatrix::matmul (GF(2) sparse-sparse multiply)
description:
Implement sparse × sparse matrix multiplication on `gf2-core`'s `SpBitMatrix` over GF(2). Filed per user decision on 2026-05-04 in response to a3412e15's exclusion proposal #2: rather than excluding the (sparse-matmul × GF(2)) cell as `schema-violation`, implement gf2-core's own SpMM so the cell becomes a self-reference (no external library lacks the symbol — none provides public sparse × sparse matmul over GF(2), so gf2-core's path becomes the canonical reference for this cell).

## Background

The sparse benchmark corpus design (a3412e15) flagged that no public sparse × sparse matmul exists in fflas-ffpack, LinBox, M4RI, NTL, or FLINT. Without an external reference, the cell either gets excluded or becomes a self-reference cell (gf2-core's own implementation is the canonical numbers). This task implements the gf2-core path so the cell can be filled with a self-reference number rather than excluded.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `SpBitMatrix::matmul(&self, other: &SpBitMatrix) -> SpBitMatrix` exists and produces the canonical CSR output.
- [hard] Output is bitwise-equal to `(self.to_dense() * other.to_dense()).to_sparse()` for tested input ranges.
- [hard] At least one benchmark in `crates/gf2-core/benches/sparse_matmul.rs` covers `(n, density) ∈ {(1024, 1/n), (4096, log(n)/n)}`.
- [hard] Tail-masking invariant preserved (per CLAUDE.md key invariant 1).
- [hard] No unsafe in this module — sparse matmul stays in `gf2-core` proper, not the kernels crates.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `doc-review` pass.

## References

- `dev/plans/sparse_benchmark_corpus.md` § 6 proposal #2 (the exclusion this task replaces).
- `crates/gf2-core/src/sparse/` for the existing CSR structure.
